  • Cutoff Marks

  • Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Core Syllabus): Arithmetic & Advance Maths के सभी फॉर्मूले, Reasoning के Coding-Decoding/Series/Analogy पैटर्न, और NCERT आधारित Static GK व Science के मुख्य कॉन्सेप्ट्स पूरे करें।
  • Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): पिछले 5 वर्षों के Official Previous Year Questions (PYQs) को टाइमर के साथ हल करें। Calculation Speed बढ़ाने के लिए Tables, Squares, Cubes और Fraction-to-Percentage रोज़ दोहराएं।
  • Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & High-Yield Revision): रोज़ाना 1-2 Full CBT Mock Tests का गहन विश्लेषण (Deep Analysis) करें, कमज़ोर टॉपिक्स पर 50-50 सवाल हल करें और पिछले 1 वर्ष के Current Affairs व Static GK को पक्का करें।

📢 CG Police Bilaspur Bastar Fighter Constable Offline Form 2026 (417 Vacancy)

✅ VERIFIED NOTICE 📅 02 Nov 2026

Office of the Superintendent of Police, Bijapur (CG Police Bilaspur) has released the official notification for the recruitment of 417 Bastar Fighter Constable posts. The offline application process will begin on 02 November 2026, and the last date to apply is 12 December 2026. Further details are available at bijapur.cgpolice.gov.in.

📌 Category: Latest Jobs
🏛️ Sector / State: Non-Govt + Semi-Govt (All India / Central)
🗓️ Release Date: 02 Nov 2026
📜 Notification Date: 31 Aug 2026
🟢 Apply Start Date: 02 Nov 2026
🔴 Last Date: 12 Dec 2026
📊 Total Vacancy: 417 Posts
🎓 Qualification / Eligibility: Eligibility | Current or former Chhattisgarh Government employees not declared unfit for government service may get relaxation on the conditions below.
💳 Application Fee: Employment News | SC, ST and OBC candidates: upper age limit relaxed by a maximum of 5 years.
🎂 Age Limit: SC, ST and OBC candidates: upper age limit relaxed by a maximum of 5 years. | Local women of Bijapur district: upper age limit relaxable up to 10 years, under the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Special Provisions for Appointment of Women) Rules, 1997.
📄 Official Notification PDF

📋 COMPLETE POST DESCRIPTION & OFFICIAL DETAILS

📅 Important Dates
  • Post Release / Update Date: 02 Nov 2026
  • Official Notification Date: 31 Aug 2026
  • Apply Online Start Date: 02 Nov 2026
  • Last Date to Apply: 12 Dec 2026
💳 Application Fee
  • Employment News
  • SC, ST and OBC candidates: upper age limit relaxed by a maximum of 5 years.
  • Unreserved, SC and OBC 163 cm or more 153 cm or more
  • General standard 79 cm 84 cm
  • The candidate must not have any eye disease and must be able to distinguish the primary colours.
  • Written Examination Objective questions on general knowledge, intelligence, analytical ability, local geographical structure, culture, tradition, social values and arithmetic 50
  • Unreserved candidates must score 60 percent of the 100 marks. SC, ST and OBC candidates must score 50 percent.
  • Make sure a posted form reaches the Superintendent of Police office, Bijapur, by the last date during office hours. Forms received later will not be accepted.
🎂 Age Limit & Relaxation
  • SC, ST and OBC candidates: upper age limit relaxed by a maximum of 5 years.
  • Local women of Bijapur district: upper age limit relaxable up to 10 years, under the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Special Provisions for Appointment of Women) Rules, 1997.
  • Permanent government servants must not be more than 36 years old.
  • Age proof, and a certificate for any age relaxation claimed.
🎓 Qualification & Eligibility
  • Eligibility
  • Current or former Chhattisgarh Government employees not declared unfit for government service may get relaxation on the conditions below.
  • 10th class pass from a school located in Chhattisgarh or Madhya Pradesh.
  • Written Examination Objective questions on general knowledge, intelligence, analytical ability, local geographical structure, culture, tradition, social values and arithmetic 50
  • Read the instructions in the advertisement, then fill the prescribed form attached to it, in clean and clear handwriting of your own.
  • All required qualifications and certificates must be held on the last date for submitting the application, including those for bonus marks.
  • Filling the application does not confirm a candidate's eligibility.
  • The selection committee's decision on eligibility is final and binding.

  • Interview Results

  • Free AI Interview Tool
  • The competent authority will examine such cases personally and may consult the District Chief Medical Officer if needed.

  • Interview: a maximum of 3 times the number of advertised posts will be called.
  • Bijapur local resident certificate from the competent authority.
  • Competent authority certificate for Assistant Constables, ex-servicemen, former Agniveers, and Naxal-affected or relief camp families, where applicable.
📝 Exam Pattern & Syllabus
  • Cutoff Marks
  • Written Marks
  • Syllabus
  • Stage Content Marks
  • Physical Efficiency Test Long jump, high jump, shot put, 100 metre race and 800 metre race, 20 marks each 100
  • Written Examination Objective questions on general knowledge, intelligence, analytical ability, local geographical structure, culture, tradition, social values and arithmetic 50
  • Bonus Marks Certificates and local dialect knowledge 30 (maximum)
  • Unreserved candidates must score 60 percent of the 100 marks. SC, ST and OBC candidates must score 50 percent.

🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION ROADMAP

  • Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Core Syllabus): Speed Math (Simplification, Quadratic, Number Series), Seating Arrangement & Linear/Circular Puzzles के बुनियादी नियम, और Reading Comprehension व Grammar (S-V-A) की रोज़ाना 3 घंटे प्रैक्टिस करें।
  • Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Data Interpretation (Tabulated, Pie, Caselet), High-Level Floor/Box Puzzles, और पिछले 6 महीनों के Banking & Financial Current Affairs के साथ रोज़ाना 2 Sectional Timed Mocks लगाएं।
  • Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & High-Yield Revision): रोज़ाना 1 Full-Length Prelims/Mains Mock Test दें, गलत हुए सवालों की Error Notebook बनाएं, और GA/Banking Awareness का बार-बार रिविज़न करके अपनी Accuracy 90%+ पर लॉक करें।
